Neros Gives Pentagon A Small Stake With No Vote, Then Asks Who Buys
Pentagon Loans $450 Million to Unmanned Aircraft Systems Developer Neros

stories.title: ​Ghost Shark Gets Teeth – Australia Reveals How Its Extra-Large Autonomous Submarine Can Deploy Swarm of Drones e.g. Right Off China’s Coast
stories.summary: The Australian Department of Defence and Anduril Australia showcased the Ghost Shark, an extra-large autonomous underwater vehicle capable of carrying up to 24 Altius 600-series UAVs, 12 smart sea mines, and cargo containers. Serial production is scheduled to begin in late 2025, with Australia having ordered dozens of these vehicles for 1.12 billion US dollars.

stories.title: Robot-by-the-Hour Startup Tutor Intelligence Raises $75M Series B
stories.summary: Tutor Intelligence raised a $75 million Series B, bringing its total capital to $117 million. The Watertown, Massachusetts company plans to use the funds to train robot foundation models and deploy its Sonny and Cassie robots, aiming for more than 1,000 units under contract by the end of 2027.

stories.title: Tesla Tests About Two Dozen Cybercabs on Detroit Roads
stories.summary: Tesla is testing about two dozen Cybercabs on public roads around Metro Detroit, operating from its Southfield facility with human drivers and temporary steering wheels. The vehicles have been spotted on I-696, M-10, Telegraph Road, and Eight Mile Road, though Tesla has not announced a date for public rides.

stories.title: French Navy's new ship-launched radar decoy drone to begin flight tests in 2027
stories.summary: The French Defence Procurement Agency (DGA), Thales, and Lacroix are developing a ship-launched drone decoy to protect French Navy surface vessels from anti-ship missiles. Flight testing of the first aerial prototype, named Dauphin, is scheduled for 2027.

stories.title: Urban rail industry news round-up
stories.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi inaugurated India's 23.3 km Pune Metro Line 3 on November 3, with passenger services starting the following day. In Australia, the Victorian Infrastructure Delivery Authority announced the preferred bidder to rebuild Sunshine station and committed to starting Stage 2 works in 2028.

stories.title: First full-scale X-BAT combat drone prototype packs 2,000-mile range, vertical flight
stories.summary: Shield AI completed the first full-scale X-BAT combat drone prototype and is transporting it to Newton, Kansas, for testing. The aircraft uses a GE Aerospace F110 turbofan for vertical takeoffs and landings, with internal weapons bays accommodating munitions weighing up to 2,000 pounds.

also.title: Shield AI Reveals X-BAT 001 Autonomous Fighter with Redesigned Air Intake and Installed Engine Ahead of Flight Tests

stories.title: United Airlines doubts Boom Supersonic's targeted schedule
stories.summary: United Airlines CEO Scott Kirby stated on October 28, 2026, that Boom Supersonic will likely miss its 2029 entry-into-service target due to complex development and regulatory certification processes. United signed a June 2021 agreement for 15 Overture aircraft, contingent on meeting performance and safety criteria, while Boom Supersonic completed assembly of its first Sprint Core prototype engine on October 22, 2026.

stories.title: Developing the robotics industry: Vietnam prioritizes industry, logistics, and agriculture.
stories.summary: Le Minh Nhat, a PhD student in Computer Science at George Mason University, advised Vietnam to prioritize industrial production, logistics, and agriculture for robotic applications. He suggested leveraging strengths in information technology, artificial intelligence, and system integration to build domestic technological capabilities while using imported components in the short term.

stories.title: DJI Dock 4 Lands in Tatra Mountains: Autonomous Rescue, No Handler Required
stories.summary: Poland's TOPR deployed DJI Dock 4 in the Tatra Mountains, enabling autonomous drone rescue missions without a human handler. The system uses a 25-second battery swap and mountaintop relay nodes to support Beyond Visual Line of Sight operations across the range.

stories.title: Florida DOT Stages eVTOL 'Flying Car' Demonstration Flight Between Tampa and St. Petersburg
stories.summary: The Florida Department of Transportation held a piloted electric vertical takeoff and landing (eVTOL) demonstration flight between Tampa and St. Petersburg on Friday. The flight was part of the Federal Aviation Administration's eVTOL and Advanced Air Mobility Integration Pilot Program.

stories.title: Purdue-Owned Windracers ULTRA Is First Autonomous Aircraft to Fly BVLOS in Indiana Drone Corridor
stories.summary: Windracers announced on November 2, 2026 that a Windracers ULTRA autonomous aircraft owned by Purdue University was the first autonomous aircraft to complete a beyond visual line of sight (BVLOS) flight in the new Indiana Drone Corridor. The flight covered more than 50 miles of a corridor that stretches over 200 miles, and took place during the corridor's opening event at Terre Haute Regional Airport.

stories.title: Volkswagen and Stellantis advance self-driving car plans in China and France
stories.summary: Volkswagen Group China secured a Level 3 autonomous driving road test permit in Hefei, China, authorizing real-world testing and large-scale data collection. Stellantis announced partnerships with Wayve, Nvidia, and the French government to advance autonomous vehicle deployment in France, and with Bolt and the Métropole du Grand Paris to introduce autonomous mobility services by experimentation across Greater Paris starting in 2028.

stories.title: Why Spain Is Losing Control Of Its High-speed Rail Network
stories.summary: A state-operated Renfe train collided with a stationary Iryo service near Urda, killing 69 people, including two Australians. Investigators cite a control center error that cleared the Renfe train to move despite an active safety halt.

also.title: Spain to Overhaul High-Speed Rail Safety Following Crash that Killed 69

stories.title: THE KOREA INDUSTRY DAILY: ROBOTWORLD 2026 to Spotlight Physical AI and AI-Driven Manufacturing With 402 Exhibitors From 17 Countries
stories.summary: ROBOTWORLD 2026 will gather 402 companies from 17 countries at the Korea International Exhibition Center (KINTEX) in Goyang, South Korea, from Nov. 4–7. The 1,198-booth exhibition will feature Physical AI and AI-driven manufacturing systems, with international participants including Taiwan's Advantech, Japan's FANUC, and China's Booster Robotics, PAXINI, and Unitree.

stories.title: General Atomics, AFRL Eye Next Steps for Autonomous Drone Concepts
stories.summary: General Atomics is developing a hybrid-electric flying wing drone called NextGen, capable of flying more than 60 hours, while the Air Force Research Laboratory recently flew the XQ-67A prototype under the Demon APE program to test autonomous mission systems.

stories.title: Drone Defense And Deterrence Questions In Germany
stories.summary: In early August, a small drone armed with Semtex failed to arm and explode after striking a Ukrainian Antonov aircraft parked on an isolated apron at the Leipzig airport. A second drone collided with a cargo aircraft, forcing an emergency landing.

stories.title: Railway expands parcel services for Singles' Day rush
stories.summary: China Railway Express launched a 20-day express delivery operation on Sunday to handle the Singles' Day rush, with high-speed rail capacity expected to increase 10 percent year-on-year. The service runs through Nov 20, utilizing about 1,900 high-speed passenger trains daily to carry parcels in express storage cabinets and available space.

stories.title: Drone Attack on Ozon Warehouse
stories.summary: Russian e-commerce giant Ozon reported that a drone struck its warehouse in Adygeysk, southern Russia, triggering a fire and forcing employees to evacuate. The company temporarily suspended deliveries from sellers and redirected incoming shipments to other warehouses, while Kyiv accused Ozon’s distribution network of facilitating the movement of military equipment.

stories.title: NASA X-59 Quiet Supersonic Aircraft Flies Six Times in One Week and Reaches Mach 1.53
stories.summary: NASA's X-59 quiet supersonic aircraft completed a record six flights in a single week, flying twice on Sept. 22 and twice each on Sept. 24 and 25. The run beat the aircraft's previous single-week record by two flights and brought its total to 38 test flights.

stories.title: France to Spend €63.4 Billion on Defense in 2027 as Euronaval Speech Highlights Naval Drones
stories.summary: French Armed Forces Minister Catherine Vautrin announced at the Euronaval trade show that the 2027 draft budget will increase defense spending to €63.4 billion, a €6.5 billion rise over 2026. The budget, submitted to the National Assembly and Senate in October, awaits a vote expected this month, with rejection resulting in a freeze rather than a cut.

stories.title: Tesla To Deploy Optimus Humanoid Robots To Plug In Driverless Cybercabs
stories.summary: Tesla Vice President of Vehicle Engineering Lars Moravy and Cybercab Program Lead Eric Earley revealed that the company intends to assign Optimus robots to Supercharger hubs to physically plug in autonomous Cybercabs. This robotic solution serves as a transitional bridge while Tesla deploys long-term high-power wireless resonance charging infrastructure.

stories.title: Russian builder tests unmanned cargo boat for Ob and Irtysh River supply runs
stories.summary: Russia's Pskov Boat Shipyard tested an unmanned cargo boat on Lake Pskov, with a representative of the Russian Maritime Register of Shipping attending as an expert observer. The vessel, which has a maximum cargo capacity of 1,500 kg, will soon begin delivering construction materials, food, and fuel to remote settlements on the Irtysh and Ob Rivers with no people aboard.

stories.title: Tesla crash LA — Autonomous Vehicle Hits Fire Hydrant in South El Monte
stories.summary: A Tesla operating in autonomous mode struck a fire hydrant at the intersection of Santa Anita Avenue and Central Avenue in South El Monte around 4:17 AM on the 3rd, leaving two occupants uninjured. San Gabriel Valley Water Company crews cut off the water supply after firefighters struggled to stop the flow, while authorities restricted access to the area during cleanup.

stories.title: Tesla misled South Korean customers about automated-driving tech, consumer group alleges
stories.summary: A consumer group alleges Tesla misled South Korean customers by selling Full Self-Driving (FSD) software for 9.043 million won ($6,726) to vehicles that cannot legally use it. The software is compatible with only about 20% of Tesla cars registered in the country, mainly US-made models.

stories.title: Waymo’s next robotaxi is a purpose-built Toyota bZ4X
stories.summary: Waymo announced it will use Toyota bZ4X electric vehicles assembled in Japan for a robotaxi service launching in Tokyo in 2027. The vehicles will be built at Toyota’s Takaoka plant with self-driving sensors installed on the assembly line, with initial testing starting next year.

Waymo Toyota: 1 Bold Robotaxi Deal With a Winning Partner

stories.title: Europe Plans Naval Drone Attacks on Russian Tankers
stories.summary: European countries plan naval drone attacks on Russia's shadow fleet in the Baltic and North seas, with operations overseen by Stephen Bryan. German firm Stark Defence began mass production of Vanta 24 unmanned vessels, which cost roughly 1,000 times less than a traditional frigate and can carry payloads up to 50 tonnes.

stories.title: 80 Tesla Owners Arrested For Allegedly 'Jailbreaking' Full Self-Driving Mode
stories.summary: Korean authorities arrested 80 people for allegedly modifying their Teslas to activate Full Self-Driving mode, a feature restricted to U.S.-made models in the country. Charged under the Motor Vehicle Management Act, the suspects face up to two years in prison and a fine of 20 million Korean won if convicted.

also.title: Eighty Tesla Owners Face Prosecution for Hacking Their Cars to Unlock Full Self-Driving

stories.title: Boston Dynamics unveils second-generation Stretch logistics robot with improved durability
stories.summary: Boston Dynamics unveiled the second-generation Stretch logistics robot on Tuesday, reducing internal wiring by 81 percent and upgrading joints to improve durability based on 100,000 hours of operational data. The company plans to expand supply to DHL and other global logistics firms, with DHL having signed a memorandum of understanding to introduce more than 1,000 additional units.

stories.title: Bulgaria Joins NATO Drone Defense Project After Drones Sink Two Ships
stories.summary: Bulgaria signed on October 30 to join NATO’s Air Defence Capabilities Against Lower-Level Air Threats High Visibility Project, a multinational program for buying and developing defenses against drones and cruise missiles that fly low. Defense Minister Dimitar Stoyanov signed the accession note, and the National Assembly still has to ratify it.

stories.title: China's EHang establishes regional hub in Thailand to support eVTOL ecosystem development
stories.summary: EHang announced the establishment of an overseas regional hub in Thailand to support international electric vertical take-off and landing (“eVTOL”) aircraft deployment, regional resource coordination and project implementation across Southeast Asia and other emerging markets. In the near term, EHang plans to deploy an initial fleet of 25 units of EH216-S pilotless passenger-carrying eVTOL aircraft in Thailand.

stories.title: Humanoid Robots in Warehouses vs AMRs: Which Automation Makes Sense in 2026?
stories.summary: GXO and Agility Robotics announced a commercial Robots-as-a-Service agreement in June 2024 to deploy Digit in warehouse operations. The robot handles repetitive material-moving tasks, including transferring totes to conveyors, while working alongside existing automation such as autonomous mobile robots.

stories.title: Wildwood Crest Police Use Drone to Find Missing Dog [VIDEO]
stories.summary: The Wildwood Crest Police Department used its Drone Unit to locate a missing dog in the dunes near Sunrise Park on Monday. Officers detected a heat signature using the unmanned aircraft system's thermal imaging capabilities after the dog ran off while being walked on a leash.

stories.title: Californians revolt against police drones after rapid adoption across state
stories.summary: California police departments are expanding drone programs to conduct everyday patrols and active investigations, a shift that has triggered public backlash and legal challenges. The San Francisco Police Department recently sought approval for broader drone use, while Sonoma County settled a lawsuit by the ACLU of Northern California after investigators found hundreds of warrantless searches.

stories.title: Kodiak AI Delivers Western Star 49X Trucks to Atlas Energy Solutions, Beginning Next Autonomous Chapter in the Permian Basin
stories.summary: Kodiak AI delivered the first two Western Star 49X trucks equipped with the Kodiak Driver to Atlas Energy Solutions in September. These are the first of 65 trucks to fulfill Atlas’s initial order of 100 Kodiak-equipped driverless trucks, with Kodiak on track to complete that order in the first half of 2027.

stories.title: Beta Technologies (BETA) Q3 2026 Earnings Call: Record Revenue, Guidance Raised
stories.summary: Beta Technologies reported record Q3 2026 revenue of $17.7 million and raised full-year guidance to $52 million–$57 million. The company received FAA market survey authorization for the ALIA A250 and completed a 34-nautical-mile vertical-to-vertical flight.

stories.title: Modular Gun Systems Might Make Drone Strikes Optional
stories.summary: BAE Systems and Aselsan are marketing modular deck gun systems for merchant ships at the Euronaval show, offering alternatives to accepting drone and missile strikes. Aselsan's Gokdeniz system features a twin 35mm turret firing up to 1,100 rounds per minute, while BAE Systems proposes a 40mm Bofors gun with programmable ammunition and optional integrated fire control radar.

stories.title: The United States is testing anti-drone systems at its Naval Base in Guantanamo
stories.summary: The U.S. military conducted drone defense exercises at Guantanamo Naval Base to test capabilities against small unmanned aerial systems. The training involved Joint Interagency Task Force 401, Southern Command, and the Fourth Fleet, utilizing simulated enemy forces to verify operational readiness.

stories.title: KNAPP Establishes Robotics and AI Innovation Hub in Boston, Plans 35 Jobs
stories.summary: KNAPP established KNAPPRobotics.ai Inc. in Somerville, Massachusetts, to create a U.S. robotics and artificial intelligence development hub. The facility is expected to employ 30 to 35 people by early 2027, focusing on software development, AI, and computer vision to accelerate commercialization of warehouse automation technologies.
